meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以读取 FCS 流式细胞术文件,提取其中的事件数据(转成 NumPy 数组),查看文件版本、通道名称、采集日期等元数据,还能从数据新建 FCS 文件或转成 CSV/表格。
howto.when: 当你提到 FCS 文件,要求读取元数据、提取事件数据、导出 CSV,或新建 FCS 文件时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 FCS 文件,告诉我通道名称和事件数
say.note: Claude 用 FlowIO 解析并返回元数据。

say.text: 把这个 FCS 文件的事件数据转成 CSV
say.note: Claude 提取事件并导出表格。

say.text: 用这些数据新建一个 FCS 3.1 文件
say.note: Claude 调用 create_fcs 生成文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use FlowIO to read FCS flow cytometry files, extract event data as NumPy arrays, inspect file version, channel labels, acquisition date and other metadata, create new FCS files from data, and convert to CSV/DataFrame.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention FCS files, need to inspect metadata, extract event data, export CSV, or create new FCS files.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and tell me the channel names and event count.
Convert the event data from this FCS file to CSV.
say_en.note: Claude extracts events and exports a table.

say_en.text: Create a new FCS 3.1 file from this data.
say_en.note: Claude generates the file with create_fcs.
